title: Convergent · Security
description: Boot/checker, signed Release/CVE status and security events.

panels.title: Boot evidence
panels.description: Boot facts require successful collection in this boot. LUKS is an accepted local baseline, including automatic first-run acceptance; it is not release provenance or continuous verification.

targets.expr: cv_secure_boot_verified and on() (((cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="boot"} <= time() + 60) and (cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="boot"} > time() - 315360000) and (cv_collector_success{collector="boot"} == 1) and on(node) (cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="boot"} >= on(node) group_left node_boot_time_seconds{node="host"})) and on(node) (up{job="node",node="host"} == 1))

cv_lockdown_enabled and on() (((cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="boot"} <= time() + 60) and (cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="boot"} > time() - 315360000) and (cv_collector_success{collector="boot"} == 1) and on(node) (cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="boot"} >= on(node) group_left node_boot_time_seconds{node="host"})) and on(node) (up{job="node",node="host"} == 1))

cv_luks_header_matches_release and on() (((cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="boot"} <= time() + 60) and (cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="boot"} > time() - 315360000) and (cv_collector_success{collector="boot"} == 1) and on(node) (cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="boot"} >= on(node) group_left node_boot_time_seconds{node="host"})) and on(node) (up{job="node",node="host"} == 1))

panels.title: Checker evidence
panels.description: Checker expires after 36h. Inspect sys check and /var/lib/convergent/check/last for failure categories. Crash archives remain in /var/lib/convergent/crash until acknowledged.

targets.expr: cv_checker_success and on() ((cv_checker_last_run_seconds > time() - 129600) and (cv_checker_last_run_seconds <= time() + 60) and on(node) (up{job="node",node="host"} == 1))

panels.title: Certificates - time remaining
panels.description: Daily certificate inventory; failure and measurement age are on Monitoring. Incus UI certificate is optional and remains managed by its existing owner flow.

panels.title: Time / audit evidence
panels.description: NTS and audit status are read every minute. Any lost audit record needs attention.

targets.expr: cv_nts_authenticated_sources and on() (((cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="nts"} <= time() + 60) and (cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="nts"} > time() - 180) and (cv_collector_success{collector="nts"} == 1)) and on(node) (up{job="node",node="host"} == 1))

cv_audit_lost_total and on() (((cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="audit"} <= time() + 60) and (cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="audit"} > time() - 180) and (cv_collector_success{collector="audit"} == 1)) and on(node) (up{job="node",node="host"} == 1))

panels.title: Open advisories · installed and latest
panels.description: Source: Gentoo GLSA, Alpine secdb and OpenBSD errata, re-scanned daily by the operator. fixed_in=none and severity=unknown mean upstream supplied no value. No rows means no findings only when both status verification and freshness above are healthy. Source coverage is the existing advisory gate, not every possible CVE feed.

panels.title: Security · recent events
panels.description: Authentication, denials, identity/USB/guest-key audit events, update/deferred/bless/fallback and Incus lifecycle evidence. Source identity comes from the connection, not sender hostname; last 50 records in the selected range.

targets.expr: remote_ip:in("100.80.1.10","100.80.2.2","100.80.2.3","100.80.0.10","127.0.0.1") AND ((app_name:in("greetd","tuigreet","login","su","sudo","sshd") AND _msg:~"(?i)session opened|successful su|accepted (password|publickey)|authentication (failure|failed|error|success)|failed (password|publickey|login|su)|pam_authenticate|pam_faillock|incorrect password|not in the sudoers|COMMAND=") OR (_msg:~"type=(USER_AUTH|USER_LOGIN|USER_START|1100|1105|1112) " AND _msg:~"exe=\"[^\"]*/(greetd|tuigreet|login|su|sudo|sshd)\"") OR _msg:~"apparmor=\"(DENIED|ALLOWED)\"|type=(USER_DEVICE|1137) " OR (app_name:~"^usbguard(-daemon)?$" AND _msg:~"(?i)allow|block|reject|denied") OR _msg:~"key=.(identity|usb|guestkeys)." OR app_name:in("incus-audit","slot","fetch-release","guests","convergent-watchdog","sys-firewall") OR (remote_ip:in("100.80.2.2","100.80.2.3") AND _msg:~"carp[0-9]+:.*(MASTER|BACKUP|INIT) -> MASTER")) AND (NOT _msg:~"(?i)(type=(EXECVE|SYSCALL|CWD|PATH|PROCTITLE)|type=13(00|02|07|09|27))" AND NOT (app_name:="kernel" AND _msg:~"^([[:space:]]|Call [Tt]race:|CPU: [0-9]|Hardware name:|Modules linked in:|RIP:|RSP:|R[A-Z0-9]{2}:|EFLAGS:|FS:|GS:|CS:|CR[0-9]:|PKRU:|Code:|---\\[ end trace|</?(TASK|IRQ|NMI)>|[? ]*[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\\+0x[0-9a-f]+/0x)") OR _msg:~"key=.(identity|usb|guestkeys).") | replace ("apparmor=\"ALLOWED\"", "apparmor=\"ALLOWED\" [complain]") | copy remote_ip as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.1.10") "host" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.2") "fw1" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.3") "fw2" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.0.10") "wan" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="127.0.0.1") "svc" as hostname | set_stream_fields hostname, app_name
